payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the performance of models compared to baseline models, specifically in terms of Word Error Rate (WER) and Phoneme Error Rate (PER).

claims.text: The baseline refers to the performance of the wFST models, which are purely monolingual and do not use data adaptation.
The LangID models outperform the baseline in WER 100, indicating that the baseline performance is lower than that of the LangID models.
The baseline performance is established through comparisons with various models, including the wFST-adaptation approach.
